press_references.value: Customize your cut for up to 100 minutes with this EGO 56V 21-inch cordless self-propelled mower kit at a new $650 low

product_launches.description: EGO has launched its 56V 21-inch Cordless Self-Propelled Select Cut Touch Drive Electric Lawn Mower, featuring a multi-blade system, Touch Drive self-propelled technology, and up to 100 minutes of runtime with two 6.0Ah batteries. The mower offers customizable cutting performance, variable speed, and 3-in-1 functionality for mulching, bagging, or side discharge.

overview_description.description:
Ego is making the whole ride requesting experience a whole new adventure. Creating a community of drivers and passengers who connect through an app, and have one thing in common which is their love for new adventures.
Your new adventure is one tap away!
Ego is one of the incubated startups by Badir Program for Technology Incubators.
